falseFriends.actual: Use 'фактичний' or 'реальний', not 'актуальний' (which means 'current/up-to-date'). In manufacturing: 'фактичний час циклу' (actual cycle time).
falseFriends.performance: Use 'продуктивність', not 'перформанс' (which means artistic performance/show). In OEE context, always 'продуктивність'.
falseFriends.station: 'Станція' primarily means train/bus/radio station. For production workstation, 'станція' is accepted in tech contexts but 'робоче місце' or 'виробнича станція' is more precise in lean manufacturing.
falseFriends.scrap: Use 'брак' (defective production output), not 'металобрухт' (metal scrap/junk). For production quality scrap: 'брак виробництва' or 'виробничий брак'.
falseFriends.shift: Use 'зміна' (work period), not 'зсув' (physical displacement) or 'шифт' (keyboard Shift key). 'Робоча зміна' for full form.
falseFriends.setup: Use 'переналадка' (manufacturing changeover) or 'налагодження' (initial calibration). Not 'налаштування' (software settings/configuration).
falseFriends.stop: 'Зупинка виробництва' (production stop) or 'простій' (downtime). 'Зупинка' alone can mean transit stop — add manufacturing context.
falseFriends.available: Use 'доступність' for OEE availability (equipment uptime ratio). Not 'наявність' (presence/stock availability). Critical distinction: inventory наявність vs equipment OEE доступність.

grammarNotes.caseSystem: 7 cases (one more than Russian — productive vocative). Nominative for labels: 'Доступність', 'Продуктивність', 'Зупинка'. Genitive for 'of X': 'причина зупинки' (stop reason), 'час циклу' (cycle time). Instrumental: 'мірюється у відсотках' (measured in percent).
grammarNotes.genderAgreement: 3 genders. 'простій' (m) → 'незапланований простій'; 'зміна' (f) → 'робоча зміна'; 'обладнання' (n) → 'виробниче обладнання'; 'час' (m) → 'плановий час'. Adjective endings must match noun gender.
grammarNotes.cyrillicScript: Ukrainian Cyrillic differs from Russian: unique letters ї, і, є, ґ. Russian ё, ъ, ы, э absent in Ukrainian. Never use Russian spellcheck for Ukrainian. Key terms: 'ефективність' (contains є), 'доступність' (contains і).
grammarNotes.aspectSystem: Perfective imperative for action buttons: 'Збережіть' (Save), 'Підтвердіть' (Confirm), 'Запустіть зміну' (Start shift). Imperfective for ongoing: 'Вводіть дані' (Enter data). Perfective is standard for one-time actions.
grammarNotes.numberFormatting: Decimal: comma (,). Thousands: space. '85,5%'. '1 000 одиниць'. Time: HH:MM. OEE display: 'OEE: 85,3%'. Per ДСТУ ISO 31-0.
grammarNotes.compoundPluralModifiers: Singular genitive modifier is PREFERRED for manufacturing UI labels: 'причини втрати швидкості' (reasons + loss [gen.sg] + speed [gen.sg]). Plural genitive 'причини втрат швидкості' (losses [gen.pl]) is grammatically valid but should be treated as a soft warning, not a hard error. For automated audit purposes, treat singular genitive as correct. Flag plural genitive forms for G3 native speaker review.

industryContext.oeeTerminology: OEE (Latin) is the practitioner-dominant acronym. Full Ukrainian term: 'Загальна ефективність обладнання'. ЗЕО exists in lean glossaries but is NOT used by practitioners — 6 independent Ukrainian manufacturing sources use 'OEE'. SAP Ukraine 2026 localization uses 'OEE'. Practitioner preference: english_dominant.
standardsUsed: TPM methodology (no national OEE standard equivalent to NF E60-182 or ГОСТ Р 56407)
industryContext.dominantVendors: SAP Ukraine (Digital Manufacturing 2026 localized), IT-Enterprise (Ukrainian-origin ERP/MES, 1000+ clients), 1C Ukraine (SMEs), SmartEAM (Ukrainian maintenance software).
industryContext.primarySectors: Steel (Metinvest, ArcelorMittal Kryvyi Rih), agricultural machinery, food & beverage (Ukrlandfarming, MHP), automotive components, defense production (post-2022 priority).
industryContext.euAlignment: EU candidate country (2022). Growing adoption of European manufacturing standards via ДСТУ EN adoptions. International OEE acronym usage reinforced by EU alignment.

commonMistakes: Using 'актуальний' for 'actual' instead of 'фактичний' — the universal East Slavic false friend. 'Фактичний час циклу' (actual cycle time), never 'актуальний час циклу'.
Translating OEE as ЗЕО in dashboard interfaces — practitioners expect 'OEE' (Latin). Multiple Ukrainian sources confirm OEE as the primary interface term.
Using 'наявність' (stock presence) instead of 'доступність' (OEE availability/equipment uptime ratio) — semantically different concepts both called 'availability' in English.
Using software 'налаштування' for manufacturing 'setup time' — 'переналадка' is more precise for lean manufacturing changeover context.
Mixing Russian-style Cyrillic with Ukrainian — using 'ефективность' (Russian) instead of 'ефективність' (Ukrainian), or 'оборудование' (Russian) instead of 'обладнання' (Ukrainian).
Incorrect case selection for metric labels — using genitive 'Доступності' as a standalone label instead of nominative 'Доступність'. Nominative is standard for isolated labels and column headers.

Compound plural modifier ambiguity: 'причини втрат швидкості' vs 'причини втрати швидкості' — genitive plural 'втрат' vs singular 'втрати'. Prefer singular modifier (names the concept); flag for G3 native speaker review
notes: OEE (Latin) is the practitioner-dominant acronym — ЗЕО is not used by Ukrainian manufacturing practitioners (6 independent sources + SAP Ukraine 2026 confirm OEE). Full Ukrainian term: 'Загальна ефективність обладнання'. Formal Ви (capital) in professional contexts. Ukrainian Cyrillic has unique letters (ї, і, є, ґ) — never use Russian spellcheck. Length multiplier reduced 3.0→2.5 per 50-term empirical corpus (P95=1.88, consistent with all Slavic peers at 2.5).
